primary_in_dataset.title: Défense et mise en valeur des sites et ensembles historiques - Généralités. Comité gouvernementale de cooperation dans le domaine de la sauvegard et de la réanimation du patrimoine culturel immobilier
primary_in_dataset.resume: This record is an administrative file from the Swiss Federal Archives documenting the work of a governmental committee on the protection and revitalization of immovable cultural heritage under the Council of Europe between 1973 and 1975. It contains general information and background materials rather than a direct recording of a debate or event. The file is part of the international organizations holdings.

news.title: French project uses AI to visualise how climate change will affect heritage sites

note: The record indexes Swiss-held documents on French heritage preservation efforts from 1905–1908; the linked Wikipedia article covers the broader concept of historic preservation, while the news article reports on modern AI applications to protect heritage sites.
